reason: The cited evidence shows that CoCrFeNiMo0.85 coatings have good corrosion resistance (E1) and that a different surface treatment (ultrasonic burnishing) can induce compressive stress and nanostructure to improve fatigue in aluminum alloys (E2). However, no evidence is provided that LSP specifically works on this HEA, that the induced layer can be made sufficiently deep, or that such a layer reduces room-temperature creep or enhances corrosion resistance via the proposed mechanism. The key premises linking LSP to creep and corrosion improvements in this alloy are unsupported.
